budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: First hardening of the die's STATIC x2-pair column entry dsfd_cfifo (128 die instances; VIS-ROM S81F-02 SEV1): the die (c21h, --bf-x2-static --bf-x2-pair --cfifo-colck) binds xd2[537:0]/xf2 on every instance but the bound elements.lef view (legacy meso-FIFO cfifo, 431.976x95.016) has no such pins -> 68,864 die bits unconnected. RTL = the c21h glue module (sha256 e892a5bb) with the 1-bit ports declared scalar and the two clock feed-throughs (ck->co column clock root, cr->rf return-lane clock) removed -- the die drives those nets from its column clock root (REBIND REQUEST); two ot_s81_static_column_ingress (xd on xf, xd2 on xf2; fixed epoch, no ready/credit/occupancy), outputs registered on cr. Three CTS roots (cr core / xf / xf2 lanes, related same-frequency phase 0). Pins (tools/s81/cfifo_x2pair_pins.py): x2 at the station x2i pitch 0.096 under the sinf station column (die jog 25.68 -> 0), cc/st under cci/so (jog 53 -> 0), xd2/xf2 new on S beside xd, xf beside xd, rd 0.096 pitch, cr at the core-sink centroid; outline 431.976x95.016 -> 280.8x51.84 keeping the absolute die x/y of the N-face data pins (slot change). 0 cycles vs the die glue.
